scope: read-only convergence review; no training or independent-pool scoring

existing_protocol.validation_selection: minimum validation soft CE, then classwise soft calibration discrepancy, then earliest epoch

candidates.question: Does the selected short-run configuration recover after its early validation minimum?
candidates.evidence: This is the registered formal configuration; grid layer4+head validation soft CE was non-monotone at 3e-4.

candidates.question: Does the lower update scale require more epochs to reach a stable validation region?
candidates.evidence: At 1e-4, layer4+head validation soft CE was still decreasing at epoch 3 in the short grid.

recommended_diagnostic.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation soft CE, then classwise soft calibration discrepancy, then earliest epoch
common_settings: same epoch-dependent data order within each seed

estimated_seconds_per_run.basis: extrapolation from recorded 3-epoch small_3100 runs; estimate only

recommended_diagnostic.fairness_note: This is a convergence diagnostic. Unequal early stopping is not a final hard/soft performance comparison; any later formal comparison must use a common pre-declared budget.
